result.report:
# Contract Comparison Report — No Documents Provided

Status: Unable to perform a comparison — no contract summaries or texts were supplied.

What I attempted:
- The comparison task requires at least two documents (or their structured summaries). Your input contained an empty `doc-summaries` array, so there is no text to analyze or compare.

What you can provide to get a complete comparison:
- Option A — Full contract texts:
  - Two (or more) full contract documents (as plain text or PDF-extracted text). Preferably include the file names and which is "Document A" and which is "Document B".
- Option B — Structured document summaries (recommended if full texts are large):
  - A JSON array of objects, one per document, where each object includes:
    - id or name (string) — document identifier.
    - sections (array) — each section a map with:
      - section-name (string)
      - text (string) — the section content to compare.
  - Example:
    [
      {
        "id": "Contract A",
        "sections": [
          {"section-name": "Term", "text": "This agreement lasts 2 years..."},
          {"section-name": "Termination", "text": "Either party may terminate with 30 days written notice..."}
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "Contract B",
        "sections": [
          {"section-name": "Term", "text": "This agreement lasts 18 months..."},
          {"section-name": "Termination", "text": "Either party may terminate immediately for cause..."}
        ]
      }
    ]

What I will produce once documents are provided:
- report: A Markdown comparison report summarizing differences and recommending actions.
- section-diffs: Per-section side-by-side text snippets with a difference summary and significance (major/minor/identical).
- key-differences: High-level differences with impact analysis and suggested next steps.
- summary: Executive summary highlighting the most important differences and risks.

Guidance on significance levels (how I will categorize):
- Major — Differences that change rights, obligations, liabilities, payment, term, termination, indemnities, limitations of liability, or compliance obligations.
- Minor — Clarifications, formatting, non-substantive wording, or de minimis changes that do not alter material rights/obligations.
- Identical — Substantially the same language and legal effect.

If you want, paste the documents (or the structured summaries) now and I will run the full comparison and produce the requested outputs.
result.summary: No documents were provided, so no comparison could be performed.
